en: prevention of substance use among adolescents
narrative: Relevant (2): prevention programmes, risk and protective factors, or interventions concerning alcohol, tobacco or drug use by adolescents. Partially relevant (1): substance use by adults, or risky behaviour of adolescents that does not involve substances.

cs: ochrana zaměstnance při výpovědi z pracovního poměru
narrative: Relevant (2): legal regulation of the termination of employment, grounds for notice, protection against dismissal, severance pay. Partially relevant (1): other topics of labour law, such as working time or discrimination at work.

Relevant (2): theses that build or evaluate neural machine translation systems. Partially relevant (1): other natural language processing tasks solved with neural networks, or machine translation without neural methods.

cs: ruská zahraniční politika vůči postsovětským státům
en: Russian foreign policy towards post-Soviet states
narrative: Relevant (2): Russian policy towards Ukraine, Georgia, Belarus, the Baltic states or Central Asia. Partially relevant (1): Russian domestic politics, or the policy of the EU or NATO in the region.

Relevant (2): demographic ageing in Czechia, its causes, consequences and projections. Partially relevant (1): other demographic topics in Czechia, such as fertility or migration, or population ageing in other countries.

en: automated testing and verification of programs
narrative: Relevant (2): methods or tools for testing, static analysis, model checking or formal verification of programs. Partially relevant (1): software quality or the development process without own methods of testing or verification.
